briefing.headline: Harbour and Kestrel draw 1-1 after Kestrel fightback in second half

first_half.text: Harbour pressed high and generated most of the high regains and chances early, producing 19 high regains and 0.75 xG in the first half while Kestrel managed just 0.04 xG.
Kestrel sat deeper and concentrated play on their right, keeping their PPDA high (11.2) and registering few final-third entries (12) in the first half.

changes.text: Kestrel shifted to a more central and right-heavy attacking pattern after the break, increasing central channel entries from 0.44 to 1.33 per window and right entries from 0.78 to 1.00 per window.
Harbour eased their pressing — their PPDA rose from 3.3 to 4.4 (a 33% increase) — and their high regains barely changed, falling only from 2.11 to 2.00 per-window.
Kestrel grew into the game and flipped territorial control in the middle and final third: their final-third entries rose from 12 to 23 and xG jumped from 0.04 to 1.01 in the second half.

predictions.text: Harbour will try to reduce Kestrel's right-channel entries by at least 30%.
Harbour's pressing intensity will decline, increasing their PPDA by at least 20%.
Harbour will increase their final-third entries by at least 20%.
Kestrel will try to reduce Harbour's left-channel entries by at least 30%.
Kestrel will drop a midfielder to reduce Harbour's high regains by at least 30%.
Kestrel will increase their possession by at least 10%.

result.text: The match ended level as Harbour's eased pressing and Kestrel's improved attacking presence in the second half produced a balanced finish (final score 1-1).

removed_claims: first_half: Harbour dominated possession in the final third and attacked mainly down their left, delivering 78.2% of their final-third passing to that channel at half-time.
result: Kestrel's second-half tactical shift paid off: they doubled their final-third entries (12 to 23) and generated 1.01 xG after the break, overturning Harbour's first-half lead to make it 1-1.

result: Harbour's reduction in left-side attacks and lower final-third activity (34 entries down to 26) removed the momentum that produced their opening goal, leaving them unable to add to their 1.00 first-half strike total.
